title: Documenting so recovery does not depend on one person being awake

videos.script: Every system has somebody who knows where everything is. On the night it breaks, that person is asleep, or gone. {{person}} A runbook moves the decisions from that night to a calm afternoon. The test of one is simple: give it to somebody else, and watch. {{test}} You write one for the cluster you built, every scenario in the same shape, every command copied from a run that worked. {{format}} Its first page prints itself, from the system, every time. {{status}} And a check reads the runbook and asks every address in it whether it answers. One of them does not. {{check}} The rest of the course is in that page: the backups it points to, the machinery it describes, and the rehearsals that keep it true. {{course}}
